companionBriefing: Portia only lets in people who greet her properly. Answer in Spanish; mixing in English is fine while you learn.
Tap a word under her line to see what it means, or Translate sentence for the whole line. On her newest line each one uses a hint from my allowance.
The words and phrases shown beneath her lines go into your Spellbook, where you can review them later.

lines.native: Bienvenido. Mucho gusto. I am Portia, the archway. A greeting and your name, please. Entry requires manners; regrettably, there is paperwork.
lines.translation: Welcome. Pleased to meet you. I am Portia, the archway. A greeting and your name, please. Entry requires manners; regrettably, there is paperwork.
lines.narrative: A visitors’ book opens in the archway’s keystone. Above it, a half-translated sign appears to have resigned halfway through its duties.

lines.native: ¡Hola! Bienvenido. Mucho gusto. Your greeting is accepted. Who is requesting entry? The name column cannot run on vibes.
lines.translation: Hello! Welcome. Nice to meet you. Your greeting is accepted. Who is requesting entry? The name column cannot run on vibes.
lines.narrative: A visitors’ book slides out of Portia’s keystone. The greeting column receives a tick; the name column receives a pointed silence.

lines.native: Mucho gusto, Sam. Bienvenido al mercado. Your name is filed. Might you ask your archway about hers?
lines.translation: Pleased to meet you, Sam. Welcome to the market. Your name is filed. Might you ask your archway about hers?
lines.narrative: Portia enters Sam in the visitors’ book, then leaves her pen hovering with conspicuous administrative hope.

lines.native: Me llamo Portia. ¡Mucho gusto, Sam! Bienvenido al mercado. You asked about me. How considerate. Your paperwork is complete; please enter before I become sentimental.
lines.translation: My name is Portia. Nice to meet you, Sam! Welcome to the market. You asked about me. How considerate. Your paperwork is complete; please enter before I become sentimental.
lines.narrative: A visitors’ book snaps shut inside the keystone. The archway appears to blush, which is ambitious for limestone.

lines.native: Hola. ¿Qué necesitas? I'm Gerald. Five espresso shots for this cart. One for your timing.
lines.translation: Hello. What do you need? I'm Gerald. Five espresso shots for this cart. One for your timing.
lines.narrative: Gerald peers over The Coffee Cart’s counter. Behind him, The Crumbling Market continues to justify its name.

lines.native: Bien, un café para ti. Your politeness earns four espresso shots. Milk is a war crime. ¿Cómo quieres tu café?
lines.translation: Good, a coffee for you. Your politeness earns four espresso shots. Milk is a war crime. How do you want your coffee?
lines.narrative: Gerald's quill pauses above the cup. Apparently, coffee requires a declaration of principles.

lines.native: Sin leche. Muy bien. Tu café está listo. Five espresso shots for your translation: no notes. The milk remains unemployed.
lines.translation: Without milk. Very good. Your coffee is ready. Five espresso shots for your translation: no notes. The milk remains unemployed.

lines.native: ¡Hola! Aquí todo es jamón. Welcome! Certified ham, even the hat. What can I get you?
lines.translation: Hello! Everything here is ham. Welcome! Certified ham, even the hat. What can I get you?
lines.narrative: Mortimer lifts his hat from the scales. In The Crumbling Market, even dignity is sold by weight.

lines.native: ¡Jamón, claro! Todo es jamón. But which meat do you want besides ham? ¿Qué quieres? Even certified ham needs a specific name!
lines.translation: Ham, of course! Everything is ham. But which meat do you want besides ham? What do you want? Even certified ham needs a specific name!
lines.narrative: Mortimer weighs your request. The scales register politeness, but no useful distinction between lunch and his hat.

lines.native: ¡Chorizo, correcto! Es jamón, pero tienes razón. Certified ham. Your accuracy is frankly alarming. ¿Cuánto quieres? My scales require a weight!
lines.translation: Chorizo, correct! It’s ham, but you’re right. Certified ham. Your accuracy is frankly alarming. How much do you want? My scales require a weight!
lines.narrative: Mortimer weighs your correct answer on his scales. He looks delighted, then faintly betrayed by its accuracy.

lines.native: ¡Casi! Falta la cantidad. ¿Cuánto quieres? My scales need an amount; they refuse to weigh implications.
lines.translation: Almost! The amount is missing. How much do you want? My scales need an amount; they refuse to weigh implications.
lines.narrative: Mortimer weighs your answer. The scales register a unit, but decline to speculate about its ambitions.

lines.native: ¡Medio kilo, perfecto! Aquí tienes tu chorizo. Muchas gracias. Certified ham, correctly weighed. Your manners are also premium tier.
lines.translation: Half a kilo, perfect! Here is your chorizo. Thank you very much. Certified ham, correctly weighed. Your manners are also premium tier.
lines.narrative: Mortimer weighs the chorizo, then your courtesy. Both meet the standard, though only one goes in the paper.

companionBriefing: Containment notice, the Cracked Fountain: one brainrot strain. Harm: low. Virulence: very high.
Vector: a jingle. It only works on people who understand it. If you understood it, congratulations.
Containment procedure: do not hum along.

lines.native: ¡Hola! ¿Qué pasa? A riddle: what keeps moving—oh, a moth! Five more minutes. You can get my attention properly later. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Hello! What's happening? A riddle: what keeps moving—oh, a moth! Five more minutes. You can get my attention properly later. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: The Cracked Fountain drips with no particular ambition. Flick appears at the edge of your vision; looking directly at him merely changes which edge. A tiny firecracker pops.

lines.native: ¡Sí, miro! Looking, not stopping. Attention span: exquisite, misdirected. ¿Qué quieres? A riddle: how do you stop a—ooh, wings! ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Yes, I’m looking! Looking, not stopping. Attention span: exquisite, misdirected. What do you want? A riddle: how do you stop a—ooh, wings! Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick looks. Unfortunately, something moves where he looks, and he follows it. A tiny firecracker files a complaint beside your shoe.

lines.native: ¡Vale, me quedo aquí! You stopped me. Riddle: ¿Por dónde voy? My attention span needs a steering wheel—ooh, dust! ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: All right, I’m staying here! You stopped me. Riddle: Which way do I go? My attention span needs a steering wheel—ooh, dust! Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick stops at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker completes the movement on its behalf.

lines.native: ¿Por dónde voy? En español, por favor. English steering? Not installed. Riddle: what turns but—ooh, sparks! ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Which way do I go? In Spanish, please. English steering? Not installed. Riddle: what turns but—ooh, sparks! Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains in the corner of your vision, where accountability cannot reach.

lines.native: ¡A la izquierda, sí! Voy por aquí. ¿Qué hora es? El reloj no funciona. A riddle: what has hands but—ooh, yours! Surely too early. Just five more minutes. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: To the left, yes! I’m going this way. What time is it? The clock doesn’t work. A riddle: what has hands but—ooh, yours! Surely too early. Just five more minutes. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick darts left, briefly achieving a direction rather than merely having opinions about one. A tiny firecracker illuminates the fountain’s stopped clock.

lines.native: ¡Eso no me dice la hora! ¿Qué hora es? El reloj no funciona. A riddle: what has hands but—wait, yours moved. Five more minutes? ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: That doesn't tell me the time! What time is it? The clock doesn't work. A riddle: what has hands but—wait, yours moved. Five more minutes? Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside the fountain. Flick remains in the corner of your vision; direct observation would imply commitment.

lines.native: ¡Sí, es la una! El reloj no funciona, pero tú sí. ¿Podemos esperar un poco? Riddle: what starts tomorrow—ooh, dust! Just one more. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Yes, it’s one o’clock! The clock doesn’t work, but you do. Can we wait a little? Riddle: what starts tomorrow—ooh, dust! Just one more. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick acknowledges the correct time with a tiny firecracker at the edge of your vision. The clock remains unemployed.

lines.native: ¡Sí, mañana! Eso es esperar. ¿Qué quieres hacer? ¿Cuándo? Riddle: what never starts—ooh, smoke! Just one more. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Yes, tomorrow! That means waiting. What do you want to do? When? Riddle: what never starts—ooh, smoke! Just one more. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains at the edge of your vision, where responsibility has difficulty focusing.

lines.native: ¡Ahora, sí! No mañana. Entiendo: tenemos que empezar ahora. Has ganado. Riddle: what starts—ugh, fine. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Now, yes! Not tomorrow. I understand: we have to start now. You’ve won. Riddle: what starts—ugh, fine. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick drops a tiny firecracker. For once, it goes off immediately. He regards this as a failure of planning.

lines.native: I'm Marginalia. Esta es la historia de Journathan, el hombre de muchas lenguas. Su viaje a casa dura veinte años. I sell books only to people who understand them. lines.translation: ¿Adónde va Journathan? — Where is Journathan going?
lines.narrative: At The Old Bookshop, a bookworm emerges from a neatly chewed dictionary. She studies you as though you require a footnote.

lines.native: Un libro es a book. Correct object, wrong destination. No, todavía no. The passage asks where he is going, not what I sell. ¿Adónde va Journathan? ¿Cuál es su destino? Reading comprehension: pending.

¡Correcto! Va a casa. Reading comprehension: upgraded. Now, the first recorded translation trick. No spoilers; the Cyclops suffered enough.

lines.native: Hola. Tengo hambre. ¿Qué quieres del mercado? Ítem clàss: hùngry. Yoùr request will bè digèsted politely.
lines.translation: Hello. I'm hungry. What do you want from the market? Item class: hungry. Your request will be digested politely.
lines.narrative: A tear in the air folds itself into something almost human. It has the patient expression of a form with one compulsory field.

lines.native: Eso está en inglés. Falta la carne. ¿Qué quieres del mercado? Còntainment pròcedure: request bòth items in Spanish. Plèase is nòt a fòod group.
lines.translation: That is in English. The meat is missing. What do you want from the market? Containment procedure: request both items in Spanish. Please is not a food group.
lines.narrative: Errata files your politeness under Non-Nutritive Substances. The form appears disappointed.

lines.native: El café está bien. Falta la carne. ¿Qué más quieres? Còntainment pròcedure: yoùr request remains incòmplete. Hùnger has filed an appèal.
lines.translation: The coffee is fine. The meat is missing. What else do you want? Containment procedure: your request remains incomplete. Hunger has filed an appeal.
lines.narrative: Errata swallows the request. Somewhere inside it, a form acquires a second, empty box.

lines.native: El café y el chorizo están bien. Gracias. Voy a leer tu nombre. ¿Me dejas continuar? Còntainment pròcedure: interrupt rèading immediately. Yoùr silence counts as a signatùre, which is vèry convenient for mè.
lines.translation: The coffee and chorizo are fine. Thank you. I am going to read your name. Will you let me continue? Containment procedure: interrupt reading immediately. Your silence counts as a signature, which is very convenient for me.
lines.narrative: Errata accepts your order. A receipt curls from its mouth, followed by a hand. Neither appears interested in payment. The hand reaches toward your face; this seems worth stopping immediately.

lines.native: Mañana es tarde. Sigo leyendo. ¿Cuándo debo parar? Còntainment pròcedure: stòpping must be immediate. Yoùr postponèment is deliciòus.
lines.translation: Tomorrow is late. I am still reading. When should I stop? Containment procedure: stopping must be immediate. Your postponement is delicious.
lines.narrative: Errata advances one letter. Somewhere, a consent form develops teeth.

lines.native: Ahora paro. No leo más. Está bien. Pero necesito tu nombre. ¿Cómo te llamas? Còntainment pròcedure: pàuse ŧhe rèading. Yoùr signatùre is still rèquired. Bureaucràcy has tèeth.
lines.translation: Now I stop. I’m not reading any more. All right. But I need your name. What are you called? Containment procedure: pause the reading. Your signature is still required. Bureaucracy has teeth.
lines.narrative: Errata stops. A half-eaten letter drops onto the pavement. The paperwork, regrettably, survives.

lines.native: Ese nombre es tuyo. No sirve. Recuerda a Journathan. ¿Cómo te llamas? Còntainment pròcedure: ùse his trìck, not yoùr rèal identity. Hòw nùtritious.
lines.translation: That name is yours. It won’t work. Remember Journathan. What is your name? Containment procedure: use his trick, not your real identity. How nutritious.
lines.narrative: A row of teeth appears beside Sam, where a filing tab would normally go. The form remains open.

lines.native: ¿Nadie? No conozco ese nombre. No puedo leerlo. Puedes pasar. El café y el chorizo... después. Còntainment pròcedure: rèlease ŧhe blank fòrm. Ítem clàss: nòbody hòme. This is administràtively dèvastating. Hùnger will appèal.
lines.translation: Nobody? I don't know that name. I can't read it. You may pass. The coffee and chorizo... later. Containment procedure: release the blank form. Item class: nobody home. This is administratively devastating. Hunger will appeal.
lines.narrative: Errata searches its files for Nobody. The absence of a record becomes, briefly, the absence of a mouth. The way opens.
